# Opteryx OData Service - LLM directives (machine readable)
# Not an IETF standard; used by our tooling to find LLM guidelines
# Last-Updated: 2026-01-20

Service: Opteryx OData Service
Base-URL: https://odata.opteryx.app/api/v4/
Human-Instructions-Doc: /LLM_INSTRUCTIONS.md
Repository: https://github.com/mabel-dev/odata.opteryx.app
Contact: mabel-dev (repo maintainer)

# Rules (machine-friendly key/value)
Mandatory-Top: true
Top-Default: 100
Top-Recommendation: 50
Expand-Supported: false
Expand-Notes: Avoid $expand and Nav/$count; ask for alternatives or permission to sample with $top=1
Output-Format: single-line URL-encoded query string (exactly one)
Mod-Mixed-Type-Supported: false
Case-Sensitive-Strings: true
Require-Schema: true
Schema-Endpoint-Template: /api/v4/{workspace}/{collection}/{dataset}/$metadata

# Short examples (URL-encoded)
Example-Select-Top: ?$select=name%2Cnumber_of_moons&$orderby=number_of_moons%20desc&$top=1
Example-Aggregation: ?$apply=groupby((region),aggregate(sum(sales)%20as%20Total))&$orderby=Total%20desc&$top=10

# Guidance summary: If schema missing, ASK for schema. If user requests unsupported feature ($expand, Nav/$count), respond with a concise refusal and offer a safe alternative.
